text.jp:
キリークさん！
またお話を聞かせてもらってもいい？
text.official_en:
Hey, Creek. Any chance I can hear another one of
your stories?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク

text.jp:
もちろんだとも。
今日も俺の過去の戦いに関する話を所望かね？
text.official_en:
Of course. Shall I regale you with another of my
past battles?

text.jp:
そうなの。今読んでいる「アラゴ西方戦史」が
キリークさんたちの出てくる場面でね。
text.official_en:
Sure. I was just reading Arago: Chronicles of the
Western War, and you're in it.

text.jp:
難攻不落の山城を攻略しに行くところなの！
実際の戦いの様子を直接聞きたくて……！
text.official_en:
I'd love to get your firsthand account of how you
took the impenetrable mountain fortress.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あれか。まず最初は斥候を放って周辺の地形から
城への進入路を探ることだったな……
text.official_en:
Ah, that. Well, first we dispatched scouts to find an
unguarded route to the castle. Once that was done...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

text.jp:
……なるほど、そうやって攻め落としたのね！
とっても参考になったわ！
text.official_en:
I see. So that's how you captured it. This gives me a
lot to think about.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

text.jp:
頭の中に鮮やかに光景が思い浮かんで
まるでその場にいるみたいに感じたの！
text.official_en:
The way you tell the story, I can see every detail.
It's like I'm right there.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク

text.jp:
当事者が語っているのだから当たり前だがな。
そう喜んでくれるのは悪い気はしない。
text.official_en:
One of the perks of eyewitness testimony. I'm glad
you appreciated the tale.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク

text.jp:
記録には華やかな活躍ばかりが残されて、
実態とかけ離れてしまうこともしばしばだ。
text.official_en:
Official records only retain the grandest of exploits.
They often print the legend, not the truth.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク

text.jp:
重厚な軍記に目を通した上、当事者目線の話や
軍略にも関心を抱いてくれるのは嬉しいよ。
text.official_en:
I'm pleased that you looked beyond those weighty
tomes for a firsthand account of the tactics involved.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

text.jp:
そんな！　感謝するのはこちらのほうよ！
いつも話を聞かせてもらってるんだもの。
text.official_en:
You're pleased? I'm the one who gets to hear your
wonderful stories.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

でも聞きたいことはまだまだあるの。
撤退する敵軍を追撃した時のことで……
text.official_en:
But there's so much more I want to ask. Like, when
you pursued the retreating army...

text.official_en: I am so sorry. I've kept you talking for way too long.

大アウグスト殿のことを聞けたのだからな。
text.official_en:
I don't mind. Especially since you shared your own
stories of the Great August.

You're so kind to want to hear about my grandpa.
My stories just kept going and going.

out in the sticks?

the Great August as a man, rather than a prodigy.

Really? But Creek, your tactics are diametrically
opposed from what Grandpa taught.
